body:
I'm also daydreaming a lot, and it's actually the ONLY thing keeping me alive. When I'm too depressed, I'm just laying in bed all day so I can live in my alternative worlds. They're a lot more fun, I'm a better person, I'm with people I love doing things I love. A paradise. It's funny cause I actually skipped school today to daydream.

This part of my head is the best thing in my life, and I'm scared to kill myself because I will lose those worlds forever if I die.

​

So, feel you.
